notes: v7.6.5: A gate that can hang wedged the whole Grok session. assumption_gate's drive check probed every letter A-Z with os.path.isdir, which blocks for seconds per letter on a sleeping or disconnected network drive, so the hook outlived Grok's 15s timeout - and Grok does not recover from killing a hook. The check now reads the GetLogicalDrives bitmask (measured 6ms, never touches a device; disconnected-but-mapped letters count as existing, the fail-open direction). Both gates also gained a hard watchdog: a daemon timer os._exit(0)s the process at 10s (pre) / 25s (stop), under every host's timeout (Grok/Claude/Codex 15/30, Hermes 20/40), so a host is never again forced to kill a hook. Verified: stdin held open forever -> gate exits at 2s; hung process under the watchdog pattern dies at budget; bad-drive command still denied; all four providers' wired commands exit 0. Fixed copies synced to the Skyrim-AI-V5 install root, the bundle's Codex plugin source, and Codex's live plugin cache. PACK GATE: PASS.
